description: Source code for the Student doctype in ERPNext Education module, defining the Student class with validation, enrollment, and utility methods.

classes.name: Student
classes.description: Represents a student in the ERPNext Education module with methods for validation, enrollment, and profile management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates student data, sets title, and updates linked doctype names.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Checks date fields for logical consistency.

methods.name: update_student_name_in_linked_doctype
methods.description: Updates student name in linked doctypes.

methods.name: check_unique
methods.description: Ensures the student applicant is unique.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Creates a user account after student record insertion if not skipped.

methods.name: create_student_user
methods.description: Creates a website user for the student.

methods.name: update_applicant_status
methods.description: Marks the student applicant as admitted.

methods.name: get_all_course_enrollments
methods.description: Retrieves all course enrollments for the student.

methods.name: get_program_enrollments
methods.description: Retrieves all program enrollments for the student.

methods.name: get_topic_progress
methods.description: Gets progress details for a specific topic.

methods.name: enroll_in_program
methods.description: Enrolls the student in a program.

methods.name: enroll_in_course
methods.description: Enrolls the student in a course.
